text: Make an 8-second widescreen mini-documentary introducing the real F-35A Lightning II. Show it taking off from a runway, then flying, with realistic aircraft proportions—not a sci-fi jet. Label it 'F-35A Lightning II', and have 'One engine' and 'Conventional takeoff' appear in turn. Include calm English narration explaining that it has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?
